runtime_device.render_mode: Original swangle emulator mode; emulator-only MediaCodec surface output. Physical Android devices retain the normal libmpv GPU configuration.

limits: Runtime validation used an owned API35 x86_64 emulator, not a physical ARM Android phone. ARM ABI packaging and native binary correspondence were verified separately.
Decoder tests use synthetic local WebM/HLS through the same private API/relay/storage/lifecycle code. They do not prove availability of every third-party media source.
The emulator ran without audible audio output; this report asserts visible video decoding and playback state, not audible sound quality.
The attempted always_finish_activities setting did not establish recreation; only observed actual Back-finish/reopen Activity replacement is counted.
The repeated-timeline discontinuity fixture stall on emulator MediaCodec is retained as a diagnostic limitation; it is not relabeled as a passed EOF test.
Native editions require a direct or statically extracted media URL; dynamic webpage-only sources require another source.
Third-party film playback was not verified in this iteration.

diagnostic_observations.observation: Default emulator GPU context produced black frames and EGL_BAD_ATTRIBUTE despite advancing clocks. Visible decoding was not counted as passing. Emulator-only MediaCodec configuration fixed real colored frame output.

diagnostic_observations.scope: Prior test-only discontinuous HLS assets on emulator MediaCodec
diagnostic_observations.observation: Reusing six TS segments across synthetic discontinuities stalled after the first six-second boundary and then Stop waited. The UI still said 播放中; this was not evidence of normal EOF. The asset set was replaced by genuine continuous 30-second HLS. Normal HLS multi-segment decoding, Stop/replay and actual EOF now pass. The discontinuity-specific emulator observation remains unresolved and preserved separately.

Native libmpv WebM playback advances; leaving workspace pauses and manual resume reuses playback

android.assertion: Exact shipping APK starts its JNI Go backend and reaches the native search screen.
Search, workspace, library and source pages render at 320x640 with readable Chinese controls; source inspection was read-only.
Android Back from another page returns to the search screen.
Cancelling the in-app dialog retains both seeded history rows and the favorite on disk and in the visible list.
Confirming clear removes the two real stored synthetic rows and refreshes the visible list to 暂无记录.
After a full process force-stop and relaunch, history remains empty.
Clearing history retains the independently stored favorite before and after process restart.
Three Back-finish/immediate-reopen cycles retain PID 5011 and a usable search screen. New hosts start before old hosts retire; no fatal exception is recorded.
Actual search/API/ranking selects direct playable synthetic media, opens details and selects an episode.
Colored decoded frames change across multiple continuous HLS segments. Encoded video clock reaches 9.300 seconds and stored position reaches 9.366 seconds.
Stopping active HLS completes, then replay creates a fresh played history ID and visibly changing frames.
Next Episode changes to 第02集, opens a new stream/history and visibly decodes it.
A second Stop and Replay in the same process complete and produce another played history and visible frame.
Changing from HLS to WebM in the same process decodes changing VP9 video frames.
Changing back from WebM to HLS in the same process decodes changing H264 frames with continuous encoded clocks.
The genuine 30-second HLS reaches 播放结束 with encoded clock 29.933 and saved position 27.766. Stop then replay succeeds with a fresh played history and changing decoded frames.
Identical release frontend and unchanged WebM assets explicitly reach 播放结束, stop, replay changing visible frames, and play 第02集.
Leaving active workspace pauses video. Returning shows 已暂停 and two byte-identical colored-frame screenshots separated by 2 seconds; stored history position is also stable.
Manual Play after navigation pause changes the colored decoded frame and returns to 播放中.
Android Home pauses active video. Returning shows 已暂停 and two byte-identical colored-frame screenshots separated by 2 seconds; history position is stable.

Finishing and immediately reopening after actual decoded playback succeeds in the same PID 5236, creates a replacement Activity before the previous one retires, and reaches usable search without a fatal JNI/FFI exception.
